fusions.name: Bulwark Slam
fusions.desc: Drives your guard into the target, dealing 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and knocking it back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Hurled Rim
fusions.desc: Hurls the rim, dealing 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and ignoring resistances. It rebounds to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles for 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Braced Wall
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard Up
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you gain a ward that soaks 8% of your maximum health for 3 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
